newsitem.title: USA: TABLE- Saks Q2 pro forma loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: TABLE- Saks Q2 pro forma loss narrows.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: The net earnings and per share amounts are on a pro forma fully-taxed basis, after adjustment for management fees ($1 million in the first six months of 1996); interest savings related to its IPO ($10.2 million in the first half of 1996, $2.0 million in the first half of 1997); extraordinary charges ($3.3 million in first half of 1996 and $3.4 million in the first half of 1997); and income-tax benefits ($5.9 million in the first half of 1996), $8.2 million in the first half of 1997).

Including these items, the company posted a net loss of $14.2 million (0.22 a share) in the second quarter of 1997, compared with a $26.0 million ($0.44 a share) loss in the 1996 quarter. For the six months in 1997, Saks posted a net loss of $4.9 million ($0.08 a share), compared with net loss of $28.9 million ($0.55 a share) in the first half of 1996.

The company anticipates it will be required to recognize the benefit of its net operating loss carryforwards in the fourth quarter. The recognition of the net operating loss carryforwards would results in 1997 pretax earnings being subject to an estimated 41-percent effective tax rate. The company's current cash payments will be the 2 percent alternative minimum tax liability.
The company's full name is Saks Holdings Inc.
